outcome: presence of SARS-CoV-2 viral proteins (spike, nucleocapsid, ORF3a)
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 without preeclampsia during pregnancy, from whom placental villous tissues and maternal serum were collected.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection negatively impacts placental integrity, leading to increased syncytial knots, dysregulated renin-angiotensin system components, and endothelial damage.
